method: for each truth note: among the outputs with the same pitch starting within +/-150 ms, take the nearest; delta = out.start - truth.start; report the median
why_this_file: silence is the only place where "the note starts here" is not a matter of opinion, so the constant is read off the one sample where a join cannot bias it
caveat: a constant read off this file and applied to every file is a ruler, not a correction: if it had to change when the sample changed, it would not be constant
